en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a large neoclassical salon with high ceiling, crystal chandeliers hanging on long cords, tall windows with sheer curtains, and rows of ornate chairs and sofas along the walls. A piano stands at the far end of the room, and two framed portraits hang on the wall. At the bottom of the image there is a caption identifying the location as Gustafsbergs Societetssalong in Uddevalla.
